parameters.hotspot_definition: a compact cluster: 90% of its collisions within max_radius_m of its centre
parameters.month_views: each calendar month pooled across 2021 to 2025, clustered with the time-slice settings
parameters.radius_definition: 90th percentile distance from the centre, at least 25 m
parameters.label_definition: most common recorded LSOA code among the hotspot's collisions (blank when none is recorded)

persistence_rules.persistent: collisions in at least 4 of the 5 years
persistence_rules.recent: at least 60% of collisions in 2024 and 2025
persistence_rules.fading: at least 60% of collisions in 2021 and 2022

parameters.selection_rule: highest worst-case silhouette among methods with at most 50% noise in both test squares
